detail.longDescription: Such a lot of misapprehension (& sloppy language) around so-called “AI”, not least from the journos who you’d hope would educate themselves a bit more before asking questions. For my money, LATingle is the only realist in the room, & her view is that the main role of ‘middle powers like us’ (Australia) is as places to build data centres: “They’re after our water, they’re after our land, they’re after our energy - we are not going to be controlling this…” or be involved in frontier modelling. # Insiders # AI # AgenticAI # AIFrontierModels # dataMining # copyright
